manifest.selection: Every third position of the pre-existing regular lattice, fixed before measuring this sweep.
manifest.hardware: Apple M5, 16 GiB; Unity 6000.4.1f1, Metal; silent nice-15 batch, one worker.
manifest.scope: Current GPU walk; not the new offline complete-route sampler. Three computed bins, one pair, eight bounces, 0.4 s support; no DSP.
manifest.timings: Warm synchronous Solve, including path-buffer GPU-to-CPU readback; excludes CPU complex summation and cold construction.

validation: Three measurement cases completed; all expected finite rows present; 256-ray complex values and visibility exactly reproduce previous GPU fields.
metrics: Relative complex L2 and amplitude metrics computed per seed then averaged; pressure fields are never seed-averaged before scoring.
memory: Path buffer only, per pair and response. Diagnostic holds an equally sized CPU copy. Geometry/material/driver memory excluded.
limitations: Small predetermined lattice subsets, not full maps.
Three computed bins, not a full-band audio timing; synchronous GPU readback included.
Eight-interaction production GPU walk, not the two-order offline complete-route sampler.
Four seeds, with nested ray sequences as count increases; not independent replications across budgets.
Reference mesh convergence is observed, not a certified total error bound.
No 3D, moving-scene, perceptual/audio-artifact or training-data qualification.
